nodes.question: What transportation routes were involved in the supply chain of the leggings before reaching the distribution centre in South Carolina?
nodes.answer: The leggings were transported by truck to the port in Galle, Sri Lanka, then by cargo ship between Galle, Sri Lanka and Los Angeles, California, and finally by truck to a distribution centre in Spartanburg, South Carolina.
